other_failure_modes.name: Feature engineering leakage before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates train and test sets to compute group-wise means and frequency encodings. This leaks the test set feature distributions into the training data before the split.

other_failure_modes.name: Inconsistent categorical encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical columns are converted to integer codes independently for the train and test sets. If the sets have different unique values for a category, the resulting integer codes will mismatch, corrupting test predictions.

summary: The agent builds a robust cross-validated stacking ensemble with multiple gradient boosting models and performs target encoding safely. However, the solution suffers from critical data leakage by performing feature aggregations on the combined train/test dataset, and introduces a bug by independently encoding categorical features in the train and test sets, which will misalign the codes.
